title: ICE's Sprecher on Clarity Act, Polymarket Funding, Expanded Trading Hours
title_cn: ICE 斯普雷彻关于澄清法案、Polymarket 融资、延长交易时间
summary: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. Chief Executive Officer Jeff Sprecher says the Clarity Act would help define rules about crypto. He also talks about ICE’s $1.6 billion investment in Polymarket, a leading prediction market platform, and the possibility of expanding trading hours. He speaks to Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India’s Top Court Orders Inquiry Into Student Protest Crackdown
title_cn: 印度最高法院下令调查镇压学生抗议活动
summary: India’s top court has ordered a probe into police action against students during last month’s youth demonstrations, which led a minister to resign from Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s cabinet.
